subject: Better handling of nullptr in FromString String config (#550)
reason: The change hardens vmsdk config::String::FromString to reject a string_view with a null data pointer instead of silently ignoring it. This path is unreachable from any server-visible input: FromString is only invoked by ModuleConfigManager::UpdateConfigFromKeyVal when parsing module-load argv, valkey-search registers no String-typed config in production code (config::StringBuilder appears only in unit tests; all registered configs are Number, Boolean or Enum), and ParseAndLoadArgv always passes a string_view built from a real ValkeyModuleString or the literal "yes", whose data pointer is never
